main_text.p: tas feret,exponamus. Quod igitur primo loco posuimus, agendis rebus Iurisconsultos praefuisse, sic accipiendum est:ut iudiciorum,earumque actionum omnium quę tum legis dicebantur, tum etiam privatæ & extraiudiciales erant,formulas ab ijs perscribi solitas intelligamus: veluti emācipationis, adoptionis, in iure cessionis, in manum cō ventionis,testamentorũ, creationum,mancipationum,& quæ sunt generis eiusdem. Nam de iudiciorum quidem formulis vel ex Ciceronis oratiōne pro Muræna cuiuis existimare facile est, ubi illa ue-

page.notes: The running head at the top is ornamented and only partly legible; the first word group could not be read. Long s printed as f in the body was normalised to s. The printed hyphen at the line end "ue-" is kept as printed. Doubtful readings: "cō" before "ventionis" (macron form as printed), and "Iurisconsultos" (capital I as printed). The page number 22 is read from the top left and may be ambiguous in the scan.
